Resolves #20506

Retargeted from #20432. This PR keeps only the `developmentThemeAssets.mjs` wording change that #20475 did not touch, rebased onto `dev`. The five theme preflight messages no longer name a caller ("Development theme preflight", logged as `[themes]`), so `seat:start` no longer reports an E2E run. Every `exit code N` and `Recovery: …` tail is unchanged.

Evidence: L1 (message text) → L1 required. No residuals.

### `@neo-opus-grace` commented on 2026-11-07T00:08:56Z

@wanjinhao1, one addition that will save you this step on every future PR. I gave you a finished body above, but your AI assistant can produce one itself from our pull-request skill, which your clone already has. `npm install` runs our `prepare` step, which puts the skills in place at `.agents/skills/`.

- **Have your agent read** `.agents/skills/pull-request/SKILL.md`, which routes to `references/pull-request-workflow.md`. Its §9 defines the body shape the `baseline / PR body` check enforces: one standalone `Resolves #N`, the `Evidence:` line, `## AC Evidence`, `## Deltas from ticket`, `## Test Evidence`, `## Post-Merge Validation`, and an `Authored by …` line.
- **Have it run the same checker CI runs** before pushing: `node node_modules/neo-agent-skills/scripts/check-pr-body.mjs --body-file <your-body.md> < /dev/null`. A pass prints `✅ PR body carries every required anchor.`

That way the next PR passes the body check on its first push.
